headline: Bitcoin ended a quiet Friday near $81,200 while US stocks fell and oil jumped, and next week brings the Fed decision, US inflation data and Coinbase earnings.

market.asOf: BTC read from CoinDesk's bitcoin price page, timestamped 3:39pm ET 23 Oct (02:39 Bangkok 24 Oct). ETH, SOL and the Fear & Greed index could not be confirmed from a timestamped source this run, so they are left blank. Live prices are at the top of the page.

stories.title: Bitcoin stays flat near $81,200 as US stocks fall and oil jumps
stories.summary: Bitcoin traded in a narrow range all Friday while US stocks slid into the weekend, led by the Dow, and oil prices jumped. Next week's Fed meeting is the next big test.
points: Bitcoin was $81,225.50 at 3:39pm ET Friday, down 0.22% over 24 hours, per CoinDesk's price page.
US stocks fell on Friday: the Dow closed down 1.18%, the S&P 500 down 0.43% and the Nasdaq down 0.08%, per Reuters.
Brent crude settled at $116.72 and WTI was at $103.82, up 4.37%, at 3:48pm ET, per Yahoo Finance.
Energy stocks rose 2.4% to a record, while AT&T and T-Mobile each fell more than 6% after a report that SpaceX wants to become a wireless carrier, per Reuters.
Earlier Friday, CoinDesk reported crypto futures volume down 19% and liquidations down 23% over 24 hours, a sign of a calm market.

sources.label: Yahoo Finance: Stock market today, 23 Oct
Reuters (via Lufkin Daily News): Dow, S&P 500 fall to end rocky week

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs post their biggest one-day outflow since June, but the week is still positive
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, saw $635.6 million leave on Thursday 22 Oct, more than wiping out Wednesday's inflow. Friday's figures were not yet confirmed when this edition was written.
points: Net outflow of $635.6M on Thursday, the largest daily outflow since June, after $528.4M of inflows on Wednesday, per The Block.
By fund: BlackRock's IBIT -$254.1M, Fidelity's FBTC -$217.5M, ARK's ARKB -$109.4M; Morgan Stanley's MSBT took in $2.3M, per The Block.
The week through Thursday is still about +$442.7M net, per The Block.
Spot ether ETFs lost $110.6M on Thursday, while XRP ETFs took in $3.6M, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: Bitcoin ETFs swing back to net outflows

stories.title: Senator questions Tether's payments to a firm founded by ex-White House crypto adviser Bo Hines
stories.summary: Sen. Richard Blumenthal wrote to Tether, Bo Hines and Nxum, the consulting firm Hines co-founded, asking for records of their dealings. Tether says it is reviewing the letter.
points: Blumenthal says the alleged payment, made while stablecoin legislation was being negotiated, "implicates federal ethics, anticorruption, and lobbying laws", per The Block.
Citing the Wall Street Journal, Protos reports Nxum earned $6.3M from a Tether deal, with a first payment of $2.49M on 11 May 2025.
Tether says an earlier review by outside counsel "found no evidence of wrongdoing", per The Block; Nxum says Hines received no Tether-derived money while at the White House, per Protos.

briefs.title: Initia halts its network after a security incident
briefs.summary: The attacker reportedly minted tokens and cashed out about $2.6M; Initia has not confirmed the loss, per The Block.

briefs.title: Netanyahu asks for a blockchain plan in case of sanctions
briefs.summary: He said in a TV interview he wants a plan to help Israel's economy withstand possible sanctions, with no details on chain, currency or timing, per The Block.

briefs.title: Ethereum delays a Glamsterdam upgrade test
briefs.summary: A testnet fork planned for 26 Oct was postponed after ChainSecurity flagged gas-related risks in EIP-8037 and EIP-8038, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits a seven-month high
briefs.summary: The 7-day average passed 1 ZH/s for the first time since 3 March, while public miners keep shifting toward AI work, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Phantom wallet brings Kalshi prediction markets to US users
briefs.summary: Trades are funded with Phantom's CASH stablecoin; some categories are blocked in Michigan, Nevada and Washington, per The Block.

briefs.title: India's CoinDCX denies a hack after $16M of outflows were flagged
briefs.summary: Blockchain sleuths pointed to about $16M in suspicious outflows; the exchange denies being hacked, per CoinDesk.

Deposit rate 2.50% after September's hike, per the ECB. In a Reuters poll, 70 of 73 economists expect a hold and 64 expect a December hike.
Each discusses results at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Bangkok Friday).
